items.summary: Haitian community leader and drug cook who uses voodoo imagery.

items.summary: Star of the studio's productions and later a public figure.

items.summary: Ex-military arms dealer based on a yacht and a Starfish Island mansion.

items.name: Gonzalez
items.summary: Diaz's nervous middleman, used by Tommy to reach the cartel.

items.name: Hilary King
items.summary: Nervous racing driver recruited for the bank job.

items.name: Ken Rosenberg
items.summary: Cocaine-addled lawyer who introduces Tommy to Vice City's underworld.

items.name: Kent Paul
items.summary: Sleazy music-business contact who knows everyone in the clubs.

items.name: Lance Vance
items.summary: The surviving Vance brother, who partners with Tommy before turning on him.

items.name: Mercedes Cortez
items.summary: The colonel's daughter, who introduces Tommy to the club scene.

items.name: Pastor Richards
items.summary: Scam televangelist selling salvation and real estate.

items.name: Phil Cassidy
items.summary: One-armed weapons dealer running the shooting range and the Malibu heist guns.

items.name: Ricardo Diaz
items.summary: Paranoid cocaine kingpin whose mansion Tommy eventually takes.

items.name: Sonny Forelli
items.summary: Liberty City mob boss who sends Tommy to Vice City and expects a cut of everything.

items.name: Steve Scott
items.summary: Porn director at the film studio asset.

items.name: Tommy Vercetti
items.summary: Released after 15 years in prison, Tommy is sent to Vice City and ends up building his own criminal empire.

items.name: Umberto Robina
items.summary: Cuban gang boss in Little Havana who wants the Cholos wiped out.
